p22_experiment.decision: Category B: Neural Engineering, Forensics & Data Advancement

scientific_corrections.quantization_overstatement: P2.2 verified Pearson r=0.999636 across 500 test positions; this is empirical validation over a sample, not a mathematical guarantee over all reachable positions.
scientific_corrections.accumulator_overstatement: P2.2 tested 14,781 legal moves with Delta=0; this confirms accumulator correctness over the sample trace, but full correctness requires formal test suites covering all move classes.
scientific_corrections.draw_frequency_overstatement: 49.5% draw rate contributed to BCE logit compression, but BCE with unscaled targets and lack of teacher centipawn grounding was equally responsible.
scientific_corrections.dense_network_overstatement: Dense feed-forward layers can theoretically approximate higher-order interactions given sufficient parameters/data; the limitation in H1 was capacity (768->128x2->32->1) and sample efficiency.
scientific_corrections.accumulator_latency_overstatement: 0.11 us accumulator update is only the sparse input layer delta; full forward pass (hidden layers, activation clipping, scalar output) requires ~1.0-1.5 us.
